## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -16.31%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND confirm fear easing and stocks beating bonds; broad sector participation (materials/industrial leadership) provides a second independent confirmation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -16.31%) BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds ↑: SPY/TLT reflected in SPY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress RISING: HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND → HYG/LQD up.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-accommodative: UUP (1W: +0.67% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY and yield curve level edging flatter (Yield Curve level down); overall financial conditions not yet restrictive but watch credit spread (Level: 0.7323, 1W: +0.41%).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Cyclicals leading: XLB (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +14.25%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials/semis strength via ITA (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +12.48%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +7.36%) ABOVE TREND. Tech mixed but holding: XLK (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND; style: Value/cyclicals showing relative strength versus communication/consumer staples weakness.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US still strong: SPY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND; Emerging markets outperforming on the week: EEM (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +2.63%) ABOVE TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculative risk on: IWM (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +2.03%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY show risk-seeking flows; ARKK (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -0.96%) RECOVERY indicates selective momentum in thematic names.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Metals/refllation strong: CPER (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +13.49%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +11.66% | 1M: +42.41%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND — reflation trade evident.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: -0.18%) RECOVERY while Brent BNO (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -13.56% | 1M: -27.97%) BELOW TREND — commodity strength concentrated in metals, not gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Breadth (9/11) plus VXX falling and SPY ABOVE TREND validate the RISK-ON call. DIVERGENCE: multiple RECOVERY flags (IBIT, ARKK, XLE, UUP) constitute a MAJOR divergence — short-term rotational noise that tempers conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclicals/materials: XLB (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +14.25%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; favor EM exposure via EEM (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to staples/communication: XLP (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND and XLC (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION showing weakness/rotation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND, Industrials ITA (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +12.48%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Consumer Staples XLP (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND, Communication XLC (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +11.66% | 1M: +42.41%) ABOVE TREND and Copper CPER (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +13.49%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -13.56% | 1M: -27.97%) BELOW TREND and Brent BNO (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 26 (VIX complacency threshold): VXX (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -16.31%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD spread level ~0.73 (credit stress): HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND / LQD (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND. Tech vs Financials pivot: XLK/XLF level ~2.60 (Tech vs Financials) with XLK (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive.  
Materials and Industrials showing strength: XLB (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +7.94%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +14.25%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: rising credit stress via HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.29% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND and MAJOR divergence across multiple RECOVERY ETFs to monitor.
